items.title: High CPU utilization on GCP VM
items.description: Compute Engine instance web-frontend-1 has sustained CPU utilization above 90% for more than 30 minutes while request volume roughly tripled.
items.suggested_question: Why is my GCP VM experiencing high CPU utilization?

items.title: Low memory availability on API backend
items.description: Available memory on api-backend-1 has declined steadily from ~2.6 GB to under 200 MB over 90 minutes without a matching traffic increase — consistent with a leak.
items.suggested_question: Why is api-backend-1 running out of memory?

items.title: Application HTTP 5xx error spike
items.description: web-frontend-2 began returning elevated HTTP 5xx responses about an hour ago. Errors correlate with database connection pool exhaustion.
items.suggested_question: What caused the application errors on web-frontend-2?

items.title: Service degradation after deployment
items.description: p95 latency on checkout-service-1 roughly tripled immediately after release v2.4.1 was deployed; CPU rose moderately. No errors yet, but SLO burn rate is elevated.
items.suggested_question: Did the latest deployment degrade checkout-service-1?

items.title: Storage capacity warning on data warehouse
items.description: Disk usage on data-warehouse-1 climbed from 78% to above 90% during the current window and will breach capacity within days at the current ingest rate.
items.suggested_question: Which resources need attention for storage capacity?

items.title: AWS EC2 performance incident
items.description: EC2 instance batch-worker-1 (i-0f1e2d3c4b5a69788) shows near-saturated CPU and an 8x inbound network spike after a backlog of batch jobs was released at once.
items.suggested_question: Summarize the AWS EC2 incident on batch-worker-1.
